questions.q: In the approval flow built in this lesson, what is the trigger?
options: When an item is created, pointed at the SharePoint list
Start and wait for an approval
A scheduled recurrence running every hour
Get my profile (V2)
questions.explain: The flow starts with an automated trigger, When an item is created, configured against the SharePoint list — everything after that is actions.

questions.q: What does the "Start and wait for an approval" action actually do?
options: It immediately approves every request without review
It sends an approval request and pauses the flow until someone responds
It only works with Microsoft Teams, not email
It deletes the triggering SharePoint item
questions.explain: Start and wait for an approval sends the request to the assigned approver and pauses flow execution until a response is received.

questions.q: In the approval's Details field, what are the teal chips mixed in with typed text?
options: Formatting errors that need to be removed
Dynamic content — values pulled from an earlier step like the trigger
Hyperlinks to external websites
Placeholder text that must be replaced before saving
questions.explain: The teal chips are dynamic content: real values pulled from a prior step, such as the requester's name or dates from the trigger, inserted alongside typed text.

questions.q: Looking at the completed flow's structure — trigger, profile lookup, approval, condition, two branches — which of this chapter's concepts does the Condition step represent?
options: A trigger, covered in Lesson 2
An action with no further lessons needed
If/else branching logic, covered fully in Lesson 4
A loop, covered in Lesson 2
questions.explain: The Condition step is if/else branching on the approver's response, which Lesson 4 covers in full detail — this lesson only previews the overall shape.

questions.q: Besides email, where else can an approver see and respond to a pending approval request?
options: Nowhere else — email is the only option
The Power BI report canvas
The approvals center in Power Automate or the Power Automate mobile app
The SharePoint list's version history
questions.explain: Approvers can respond from their email inbox, the approvals center in Power Automate, or the Power Automate mobile app.
